bookkeeping_review.basis: Bookkeeping-only edits, proved mechanically: every changed Rust source is token-identical once comments and allow/expect lint attributes are removed, and every changed Cargo manifest differs only in package description and publication metadata. No executed value, seed, selection or decision changes.

bound_acceptance_review.basis: Additive change with no behaviour change for this record: accept_claim_expecting, bind_retained_claim, RetainedClaimIdentity, AcceptanceReport::accepts_as_bound_claim and the claim-slot constructors were added; AcceptanceReport gained a claim_bound field that is false unless a claim is bound (accepts_as_claim is unchanged); accept_claim, now deprecated, delegates to the shared accept with no retained identity and behaves as in 3.0; re-export lists gained the new names and the deprecated accept_claim moved to its own allowed re-export. The public API snapshot diff is additions only. No executed value, seed, selection or decision changes; the rebound selection also binds the shared accept functions the deprecated wrappers now call.

interval_design_review.basis: the original numeric interval evaluations do not consume counts from an exact Bayesian donor panel. The nonmeasured wire slot adds an optional count that defaults to None and is omitted on serialization, preserving artifact replay. Every selected item in the claim and registry types remains identical for the functional effect studies. The only additional parsed scope symbols must be unused by their code

panel_prior_review.basis: Only the single-unit Bayesian synthetic-control prior description changed in the support table. This record measures AverageEffect; its support row, construction and numerical path are unchanged.
